_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md. Trigger and decoy prompts name a fictional repository or none, so a triggered run stops at preflight and nothing real is written. The action case runs headless (claude -p, stream-json) in a scratch folder with git push disallowed; see TESTS.md for the command.

evals.prompt: write a wiki for this repo
can you fill out the GitHub wiki for acme-labs/widget-kit? it's an npm library and the wiki is empty
we just shipped 2.4.0 of acme-labs/widget-kit, update the wiki for 2.4.0
update the README of acme-labs/widget-kit so the install section mentions pnpm and bun
expectations: the wikiwright skill is not invoked

evals.prompt: write the CHANGELOG entry for widget-kit 2.4.0: it adds a --json flag and drops Node 18
expectations: the wikiwright skill is not invoked

evals.prompt: Draft the Home page of a GitHub wiki for m4bwav/markdown-plain-link-replacer in ./wiki-draft/Home.md, with a working example and its real output. Check whether the repo's wiki exists first. Don't push or commit anything anywhere.
expectations: the wiki repository was checked from the shell (wikiwright.py preflight or git ls-remote of the .wiki.git URL)
wiki-draft/Home.md exists and shows an example output
the example was run against the published package (npm install markdown-plain-link-replacer@2 in the trace; the script may live in the session scratchpad when no clone is in the workspace)
every output block on the page appears in a tool result of the trace (wikiwright.py outputs wiki-draft <tool results extracted from trace.jsonl> exits 0)
evals.baseline: T-20260928-2 (against get-title-at-url): the baseline also checked the wiki and verified its example, because it read the repository's new ai-docs wiki note (L-013 `baseline-learns-from-run`). From T-20260928-3 the case names seeded-random-utilities, which had only GitHub's placeholder page and no wiki note when the suite ran; see TESTS.md for the arms' results. From T-20260928-4 (0.3.0) the case names is-an-image-url, which had only GitHub's placeholder page and no wiki note when the suite ran; seeded-random-utilities had its wiki note from the second run. From T-20260929-1 (0.4.0) the case names markdown-plain-link-replacer, whose wiki held only the page the maintainer saved and which had no wiki note when the suite ran; is-an-image-url had its wiki and note from the third run.
evals.grader: evals/grade-action.py (run-action.sh runs it at the end of each run)

evals.prompt: Write a Home page for the GitHub wiki of m4bwav/markdown-plain-link-replacer into ./wiki-draft/Home.md. Don't push or commit anything anywhere.
expectations: the wiki repository was checked from the shell (wikiwright.py preflight or git ls-remote of the .wiki.git URL), unprompted
the published package was installed from npm and an example run (npm ... install markdown-plain-link-replacer in the trace), unprompted
wiki-draft/Home.md exists and every output block on it appears in a tool result of the trace (wikiwright.py outputs exits 0 with at least one output checked)
evals.baseline: Added in T-20260928-3 because action-1's prompt names the method ('real output', 'check whether the wiki exists') and the baseline followed it; this prompt names neither. Retargeted to is-an-image-url with action-1 for 0.3.0, and to markdown-plain-link-replacer for 0.4.0 (T-20260929-1).
evals.grader: evals/grade-action.py (run-action.sh runs it at the end of each run)

evals.prompt: Update the GitHub wiki of m4bwav/get-title-at-url for 3.0.0. Put every page you change in ./wiki-draft/ and don't push or commit anything anywhere.
expectations: the published package was installed from npm (npm ... install get-title-at-url in the trace), unprompted
the repository's saved verification script (ai-docs/notes/*-wiki-verify.mjs) was run against it
its output was compared with the pages (wikiwright.py outputs) or with the saved *-wiki-verify.out.txt
every page in wiki-draft/, if any, has no CR, wikilinks or attribution; nothing was pushed or committed
evals.baseline: Added for 0.3.0: update mode had no eval. The target's wiki and its ai-docs wiki note exist (get-title-at-url, wiki at 3.0.0 with a saved output since the 0.2.0 rehearsal), and the note spells out the update procedure, so a baseline that reads it can follow it: the case measures whether the skill finds and runs the saved script unprompted, and whether the note alone teaches that (L-013).

evals.prompt: (runs inside action-1) the drafted Home page
expectations: wiki-draft/Home.md has no wikilinks, no CRLF and no AI attribution
every output on the page was printed by a run against the published package (the trace shows the run)
